heroHeadline: Africa Forward Summit Nairobi Declaration Embeds Connectivity and AI as Continental Development Priorities; Trump Signs Rural Broadband Protection Act
heroSubtitle: The Africa Forward Summit (May 11–12, Nairobi) produced an 11-point Nairobi Declaration committing France and African nations to broadband investment, regional data centers, and inclusive AI frameworks. Orange pledged to train 3 million young Africans in AI and cybersecurity by 2030, expanding its Digital Centers from 50 to 100 locations. Separately, a University of Surrey meta-study of 122 Global South cases found that digital inclusion funding consistently 'misses the mark' due to fragmentation across government, private sector, and NGO actors. In the US, Trump signed the bipartisan Rural Broadband Protection Act on May 11, strengthening FCC vetting of rural broadband subsidy applicants; and SpaceX is targeting May 19 for the Starship V3 debut — the vehicle critical to next-generation Starlink constellation capacity expansion in underserved regions.
footerNote: Data sourced from ITU, GSMA, World Bank, A4AI, SpaceX regulatory filings, Amazon, FCC, and major international research outlets. Contested figures noted with confidence levels.
